features.special.title: He aha te mea motuhake o to maatau Tauwhakatere Whakaahua Wplace?
features.subtitle.desc: Whakatane tetahi whakaahua ki pixel art atahua i hangaia mo Wplace
features.free.detailed.title: Taputapu Kore Utu Katoa
features.free.detailed.desc: To maatau taputapu hanga pixel art Wplace kaore he utu. Kaore he ohaurunga, kaore he utu huna, kaore he here whakatane.
features.privacy.detailed.desc: Katoa nga mahi ka mahia i roto i to kaitirotiro. To nga whakaahua ka noho ki to taputapu - kaore maatau e tuku atu, tiaki, whakauru ranei.
features.easy.detailed.title: Whakatane Ngawari
features.easy.detailed.desc: Kaore he whakatakotoranga uaua, mohio hangarau ranei e hiahiatia. Me tuku to whakaahua me matakitaki ki te huringa ki pixel art atahua.
features.unlimited.detailed.title: Tetahi Rahi Katakata
features.unlimited.detailed.desc: Mai nga tohu iti ki nga mahi toi nui - ka whakahaere to maatau tauwhakatere i nga whakaahua o nga rahi katoa. Kaore he iti rahi koonae, kaore he whakatahe kounga.
howto.title: Me Pehea te Whakamahi i te Taputapu Peita Wplace
howto.subtitle: Whakatane whakaahua ki pixel art i 4 hikoinga ngawari
howto.step1.title: Tuku to Whakaahua
howto.step1.desc: Paato te tauwhenua tuku, tono ranei ka kowhiri koonae mai to taputapu. Ka tautoko to maatau tauwhakatere i nga hōputu whakaahua katoa.
howto.step2.title: Whakatika Pixel Rahi
howto.step2.desc: Whakamahi te nekehanga ki te whakahaere pixel rahi. Nga uara iti ka hanga art taipitopito, nga uara nui ka whakaputa pixel art chunky, waitapu.
howto.step3.title: Whakatane ki Pixel Art
howto.step3.desc: Matakitaki to whakaahua e whakatane ana ki pixel art atahua ma to maatau hangarau tauwhakatere matatau. Ka whakahou te arokite i te taima tika.
howto.step4.title: Tango to Hanga
howto.step4.desc: Kowhiri i waenganui i nga putanga iti pixel-tika, nui ranei. Ka rite to pixel art mo te whakamahi ki Wplace!

footer.independent.title: Pae Motuhake Fan
footer.independent.desc: He kaupapa motuhake, whakahaere-fan tenei paetukutuku i hangaia hei whakangawari i nga hiahia pixel art o te hapori. Kaore maatau e hono atu, whakatohungia, whakamanatia ranei e te turanga ture Wplace.
